description: Search the Alaska Statutes BY TOPIC or keyword rather than citation — "alcohol license", "murder", "child custody". Matches against the Alaska Legislature's own official CHAPTER catchlines (942 of them, across all 47 titles) — NOT full statutory text or per-section catchlines; akleg.gov exposes neither keylessly (verified live). Returns matching title/chapter and the chapter catchline; call ak_statute with a full citation (you supply the section number) for the actual text. Keyless.

limit.description: Max results to return, default 10, max 25.

name: ak_search
title: Ak Search
